media:group.media:title: Bring Universities Together at AULF 2026
media:group.media:description:
Two days of ideas, conversations, and connections in Shenzhen. From engaging discussions to meaningful exchanges, the APEC University Leaders’ Forum (AULF) 2026 brought together voices from across the Asia-Pacific on November 15–16.
Hosted by Tsinghua University and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, with support from APRU, the forum welcomed 300+ participants from 61 institutions across 24 economies, creating opportunities for dialogue and collaboration among leaders in higher education, industry, and government.
🎥 Take a look back at the highlights!

entry.title: SAME QUESTIONS. DIFFERENT CULTURES. APEC Edition

media:group.media:title: SAME QUESTIONS. DIFFERENT CULTURES. APEC Edition
media:group.media:description:
What can no single economy solve alone? At Talent Park in Shenzhen, students from four APEC economies shared their answers, ideas they’d bring from home, and hopes for APEC 2026.
From AI and healthcare to education and energy demand, their concerns spanned different fields. Their hopes for young people included research and internship opportunities, cross-border exchange, and a real voice in shaping the future.
Different backgrounds. Different answers. A shared future across the Asia-Pacific.
What’s one problem in your field that no economy can solve alone? 👇
#TsinghuaUniversity #NextGen #APEC2026 #Shenzhen #YouthVoices

entry.title: APEC Youth Talks - China and LAC toward a shared future

media:group.media:title: APEC Youth Talks - China and LAC toward a shared future
media:group.media:description:
The 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held in Shenzhen, south China's Guangdong Province, in November, and the theme is "Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together," with three priorities: openness, innovation and cooperation. In this video, four Tsinghua students from China, Chile, Peru and Mexico—four APEC member economies—share their perspectives on rural revitalization, AI development, climate change and cultural exchanges, exploring how young people from China and Latin America can learn from one another and build a more prosperous future together.

entry.title: 25 Years of the Love Reading Scholarship | Honoring Yang Jiang's Legacy

media:group.media:title: 25 Years of the Love Reading Scholarship | Honoring Yang Jiang's Legacy
media:group.media:description:

Marking its 25th anniversary, former recipients share how the scholarship has shaped their education, careers, and lives, carrying forward a lasting legacy of generosity and learning.

media:group.media:title: A Century of Discovery | 100 Years of Tsinghua's Department of Physics
media:group.media:description:

From the historic Science Building to the modern Physics Building, generations of Tsinghua physicists have carried forward a legacy of scientific exploration and discovery. As Tsinghua's Department of Physics marks its 100th anniversary, we reflect on a remarkable journey and look ahead to a new century of curiosity, innovation, and discovery.
